lead.headline: Corporate Consortium Challenges Stablecoin Duopoly
lead.tldr: A massive alliance of 140+ firms including Visa and Stripe is launching a stablecoin to disrupt Tether and Circle, signaling a shift toward corporate-led liquidity standards.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the past week and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Stripe, Visa and over 140 other businesses to launch stablecoin to rival Tether and Circle
top_signals.summary: A massive consortium of over 140 businesses, including Stripe, Visa, BlackRock, and Google, is launching a new stablecoin. This initiative aims to create a direct competitor to the current market leaders, Tether and Circle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The entry of Stripe and Visa suggests a move toward a standardized, corporate-backed stablecoin that could marginalize current issuers through sheer distribution scale.

top_signals.title: Securitize Debuts on NYSE, Issues Tokenized Stocks
top_signals.summary: Securitize has officially debuted on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). To mark the occasion, the company issued tokenized versions of its own shares on the Solana and Avalanche blockchains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Securitize's NYSE debut and simultaneous tokenization of shares creates a concrete precedent for hybrid public-equity and on-chain ownership.

top_signals.title: Securitize is latest crypto company to go public as BlackRock-backed firm sees stock jump 3% on debut
top_signals.summary: Securitize, a BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, has gone public via a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company. The company raised $400 million during the process and saw its stock price increase by 3% on its debut.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $400M public raise for a BlackRock-backed firm validates the tokenization thesis for public markets.

top_signals.title: Ondo tokenizes BlackRock's IVV ETF and Micron stock under US custodial model
top_signals.summary: Ondo Finance has expanded its tokenization offerings by bringing BlackRock's IVV ETF and Micron stock onto the blockchain. The assets are managed under an SEC-defined custodial model with settlement occurring on the Ethereum network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ondo's expansion into tokenized ETFs and stocks under a custodial model proves the viability of bringing traditional equity indices into Ethereum settlement.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered, Circle Bring USDC Into Banking System
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered and Circle have partnered to integrate USDC minting and redemption directly into the banking system for institutional clients. The initiative is launching initially in the UAE, bridging traditional finance with stablecoin infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Direct USDC integration into the UAE banking system via Standard Chartered reduces friction for institutional on-ramps.

top_signals.title: Inside Trump’s $1.4 billion crypto empire: altcoins, Bitcoin—and a stake in Michael Saylor’s Strategy
top_signals.summary: An analysis of Donald Trump's crypto portfolio, valued at approximately $1.4 billion, highlighting his holdings in Bitcoin and altcoins. The wealth is primarily driven by his family's venture, World Liberty Financial, and strategic ties to Michael Saylor's investment approach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The scale of political figures' crypto holdings indicates a shift in how digital assets are viewed as strategic reserves for high-net-worth individuals.

deals.summary: Securitize, a BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, has gone public via a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company. The company raised $400 million during the process and saw its stock price increase by 3% on its debut.

Venice AI, founded by Erik Voorhees, has secured $65 million in Series A funding. The company has reached a $1 billion valuation as investors bet on the demand for privacy-centric artificial intelligence.

eToro has led a $12.5 million funding round for Extended, an on-chain perpetual exchange. The partnership aims to leverage next-generation on-chain infrastructure to expand access to global financial markets.

Ark Invest has acquired $18 million in shares of Circle following a significant dip in the company's stock value. The decline is attributed in part to the launch of a competing stablecoin project, OUSD.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood Chain goes live on mainnet alongside 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perps and planned crypto agentic trading
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood has launched its own Layer 2 blockchain on mainnet utilizing Arbitrum's technology stack. The network debuts with 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perpetuals, and a partnership with Uniswap, while planning for agentic crypto trading.

on_the_radar.title: Europe's MiCA crypto regime is fully in force: Here's who wins and loses
on_the_radar.summary: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation has fully entered its final transition phase as of July 1. The regime establishes a comprehensive legal framework for crypto-assets, impacting how companies and users operate within the EU market.

on_the_radar.title: Former Goliath CEO Pleads Guilty to Crypto Fraud, Money Laundering
on_the_radar.summary: Former Goliath Ventures CEO Christopher Delgado has pleaded guilty to fraud and money laundering. The scheme involved taking in at least $400 million and resulting in investor losses of at least $250 million.

on_the_radar.title: Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulations42m, Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulationsTaiwan’s legislative branch has passed the nation’s first crypto and stablecoin rules, which aim to integrate the country with the global crypto market.
on_the_radar.summary: Taiwan's legislature has passed its first set of regulations governing cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. The move is designed to integrate Taiwan more effectively with the global digital asset market.

on_the_radar.title: Nasdaq brings proprietary market data onchain through Pyth8m
on_the_radar.summary: Nasdaq has integrated its proprietary market data onto the blockchain via Pyth Network's Pyth8m service. This move bridges traditional financial market data with Web3 infrastructure, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of on-chain price feeds.

on_the_radar.title: UK sets capital, market abuse rules in landmark crypto framework
on_the_radar.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has finalized a landmark regulatory framework for crypto assets, focusing on capital requirements, stablecoins, and market abuse. These rules are set for implementation by October 2027, providing a clear legal roadmap for the industry in the UK.

on_the_radar.title: Strategy may sell up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin to calm investor jitters
on_the_radar.summary: Strategy is considering the sale of up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin to address investor concerns. This move signals a strategic shift away from aggressive accumulation amid deteriorating market conditions.

on_the_radar.title: Vitalik Buterin says Ethereum's next rebuild will rival the Merge, and take three to four years
on_the_radar.summary: Vitalik Buterin announced that Ethereum is planning a major rebuild over the next three to four years that will be comparable in scale to the Merge. A primary focus of this upcoming phase is increasing the network's quantum safety.

on_the_radar.title: Binance outflows triple to $1.2B as ETH withdrawals hit 3-year high25m, Binance outflows triple to $1.2B as ETH withdrawals hit 3-year highBinance recorded $1.23 billion in weekly net outflows, up 207% from the previous week, as Ethereum withdrawals surged to a three-year high.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance experienced a massive surge in net outflows, totaling $1.23 billion in a single week. This spike was driven primarily by Ethereum withdrawals reaching their highest level in three years.

on_the_radar.title: Moonbeam Pivots From Polkadot to Base to Build AI Agents
on_the_radar.summary: Moonbeam is pivoting its strategic focus away from Polkadot after four years to migrate to Base, an Ethereum Layer 2. The project aims to build a specialized communication and settlement network specifically for AI agents.

on_the_radar.title: Revolut to delist USDT in August, citing regulatory and risk concernsRevolut notified some customers it will delist USDT after Aug. 31, with remaining holdings automatically converted into users’ base currency.
on_the_radar.summary: Revolut is delisting the stablecoin USDT from its platform effective August 31, citing regulatory and risk concerns. Remaining USDT holdings will be automatically converted into the users' base currency.

on_the_radar.title: ESMA Says Many Prediction Market Contracts Fall Under Existing EU Rules
on_the_radar.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has warned that many prediction market event contracts may already be prohibited for EU retail investors. The agency suggests that existing securities rules may apply, potentially limiting the legality of these markets without the need for new legislation.

linkedin_post:
The stablecoin market is about to face its first real existential threat to the status quo. For years, Tether and Circle have operated with a massive lead in liquidity and trust. But a consortium of 140+ businesses, including Stripe, Visa, and BlackRock, is now launching a rival stablecoin. 

What I keep coming back to is the distribution advantage. If the very rails that move global commerce (Visa/Stripe) integrate their own asset, the friction for adoption drops to zero. We are seeing this play out in real-time with Circle's stock dipping 41% and Ark Invest stepping in to buy the dip. When the infrastructure providers become the issuers, the moat for pure-play stablecoin companies shrinks. 

I'd watch whether this leads to a fragmented market of corporate coins or a new, consolidated standard that finally displaces the current leaders. The question is whether a corporate-led coin can ever achieve the neutrality required to be a global reserve asset.
